meta.title: State and market
meta.question: Should the economy be run by the state or by the market?
meta.measure: Average position on the role of the state in the economy, from 0 (state) to 10 (market)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on privatisation, the market economy, unemployment and the government's responsibility for jobs and prices, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.
